source: Explicit user decision: freeze accuracy experiments and focus on strategy expression / IR.

accuracy.accepted_scope: Finite simple graphs and selected warmed F32 hybrid single-layer execution contracts. Functional correctness is distinct from timing qualification.
accuracy.future_targeted_validation: If required by a later research claim, separately version cross-layer reuse, prefetch, shared-resource contention and multi-round state tests. Do not infer them by multiplying one-layer latency.

mainline.coupling: A strategy is a legal configuration under shared dependence, capacity, resource and causal constraints; dimensions are not an unconstrained Cartesian product.
next_deliverables: Inventory existing dimensions, supported combinations and explicit exclusions using current code.
Specify semantics and composition legality, separating strategy choices from model, profile and external scenario inputs.
Extend independent small-graph references, then compare execution/storage choices and conditional hardware sensitivity.
evaluation_focus: mechanism ablations with a common declared candidate set
conditional strategy and hardware design analysis
not_current_mainline: complete reproduction of every published system

code_audit_priorities.gap: Separate strategy semantic validity from cost coverage and runtime feasibility.
code_audit_priorities.reason: Frozen profiling must not prevent IR expressiveness analysis. Missing prices remain unknown and must still block performance execution.

code_audit_priorities.gap: Scoped storage rules with explicit shared-budget ownership and conflict precedence.
code_audit_priorities.reason: Placement has module selectors, while cache/prefetch/reconfiguration are primarily global; different module rules must share one physical capacity ledger.

code_audit_priorities.gap: Explicit region targets and legality for transformations on nonoverlapping regions.
code_audit_priorities.reason: Existing transforms compose across families, but invocation-wide targeting and family uniqueness constrain distinct transformations within one invocation.
